title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week's spotlight is Supertramp's “The Logical Song” — the bright 1979 anthem from Breakfast in America that opens with schoolboy wonder and a sunny Wurlitzer riff before lifting into one of the most singable choruses in soft-rock history. It’s sunshine-with-a-heart: joyful, restless, and just a little bit existential. In a Djembe set it lands as an upbeat earworm — the kind that has the whole room humming the hook by the second chorus.
songListNote: Song of the Week — Supertramp's bright 1979 singalong “The Logical Song” joins the request catalog this week.
